name_reason: Follows data_fd2_battle_* convention for a battle-core scratch global; descriptor 'ai_best_physical_score' accurately reflects role (best/highest priority class found for any physical-attack candidate this evaluation pass). 'score' is a descriptor, not a Ghidra address residue. Consistent with grouped siblings _target_x/_target_y/_target_idx @ 0x53C43/0x53C47/0x53C4B and the parallel scorers data_fd2_battle_ai_best_spell_score @0x53C23 / data_fd2_battle_ai_best_item_score @0x53C33. Ghidra live name matches the src declaration byte-identically.
purpose: Enemy-AI scratch slot holding the best (highest) physical-attack priority class found by fd2_ai_score_physical_attack across all reachable candidate tiles/targets; read by fd2_attack_action_dispatch and fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher to decide whether a physical attack wins the 3-way action contest (physical vs spell vs item).
logic_summary: fd2_ai_score_physical_attack resets it to 0 at entry (MOV dword [0x53C4F],0x0 @0x1427E), then for each (candidate tile, AoE target) computes a priority class (0 negligible / 8 normal hit / 0x12 kill-shot) and stores it (MOV [0x53C4F],EDI @0x144F4) together with the X/Y/idx target slots whenever the candidate beats the running best -- selected via signed compare (CMP EDI,[0x53C4F]; JG @0x144C5) with raw_damage as the secondary tiebreak. Readers load it as a full signed dword: fd2_attack_action_dispatch compares it against 0x6 and the sibling spell/item scores to pick the winning action; fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher (AI class 2 and class 0xB) checks score > 5 to decide whether to execute the physical attack.
element_semantics: Signed priority-class accumulator (single 32-bit BSS scalar). Holds one of the priority classes: 0 (raw_damage < 3, negligible), 8 (normal hit, raw_damage >= 3), or 0x12 (kill shot, target.HP < raw_damage). NOT raw damage; the raw-damage magnitude lives in a separate local tiebreak (stored at ESP+0x40 in the writer).
notes: BSS scalar in .object2; read_memory @0x53C4F returns zeros -> zero-init runtime variable, not const data. is_const=false because of the game-side writers at 0x1427E (init) and 0x144F4 (store) in fd2_ai_score_physical_attack. src comment block (btl_aisc.c lines 702-714) is already accurate and verified line-by-line against the disasm (init=0 @0x1427E, internal read CMP/JG @0x144C5 signed, store @0x144F4, class values 0/8/0x12, signed-dword readers, group membership) -> comment_verdict=keep, no Edit to src. Ghidra had a non-compliant data plate stored in the PRE_COMMENT field (per project rule, data plates must live in PLATE_COMMENT and PRE_COMMENT must not be used for data plates); migrated the (accurate) content into PLATE_COMMENT, refined it, and cleared PRE_COMMENT -> ghidra_plate_action=updated. Also dropped the stale emit-pipeline tag line (data_kind/emit_action) from the migrated plate as non-documentary. Name kept; any rename would be applied in Stage 2.
